display_long_description:
Welcome aboard... unfortunately, the plane is too heavy.

In My Dear Passengers: VR, you step into the shoes of a desperate pilot with one objective: lighten the aircraft before it's too late! 

Grab, drag, and toss your passengers out of the plane using immersive VR controls in this ridiculous physics-driven comedy experience.

Every passenger reacts with hilarious ragdoll physics, making every flight unpredictable. Throw them one by one, watch the chaos unfold, and do whatever it takes to keep your aircraft in the air.

🤣 Physics-Based Mayhem

Every passenger is a floppy ragdoll with unpredictable physics. No two flights are ever the same!

✋ Immersive VR Gameplay

Use your virtual hands to grab, pull, shove, and launch passengers overboard with intuitive VR controls.

✈️ Save the Plane

The aircraft can't handle the extra weight forever. Think fast, act faster, and keep the plane from crashing.

🎮 Features
✈️ Become a desperate airline pilot
🤣 Hilarious ragdoll physics
🖐️ Fully interactive VR controls
💥 Funny and chaotic gameplay
🎯 Easy to learn, hard to master
🔄 Endless replayability
